submitted.rationale: XRD shows a rutile InSbO4-type phase at every composition measured, with In2O3 bixbyite peaks (Q≈2.14, 2.48, 3.50, 4.11) getting stronger as In rises (idx 24 ≈ none, 15 ≈ trace, 10 < 5 < 0). EQE went up in step with the In2O3 content: 0.053% (idx 15), 0.073% (idx 5), 0.112% (idx 0). Index 0 is the most In-rich composition in the library and the best one measured.

Mixed In2O3+InSbO4, EQE 0.073%, lower than idx 0
